title: Pose Matrix V1.5
description: Position, orientation and scale of an object in a Virtual Space through a homogeneous 4x4 transformation matrix, relative to a specified Reference Frame.

MInstanceID.description: ID of the Virtual Space the pose refers to.

PoseMatrixID.description: Identifier of this Pose Matrix entry.

Matrix.description: A homogeneous 4x4 transformation matrix (16 numbers) in row-major order. It encodes position, orientation and scale of an object within the declared Reference Frame.

ReferenceFrame.description: Optional name of the coordinate system in which the Matrix is defined (e.g., UserView, World, Camera).

Precision.description: Numeric precision of the matrix values.

DataXMData.description: Metadata optionally supporting regulated exchange of Pose Matrix data as defined by AIF V3.0.

Trace.description: Provenance information identifying the producing AIM and the time of generation.
